title: The Clever Fox
text:
Once upon a time, there was a little fox. He lived in a big forest. The fox was very hungry. One day, he found a red apple under a tree.

The fox jumped and jumped, but the apple was too high. Then a wise old owl came. The owl said, "Find a stick." The fox used the stick and got the apple. He was very happy.

questions.text: Where did the fox find a red apple?
What did the owl tell the fox to find?
Why did the fox keep jumping at first?
options: He wanted the apple very much
He wanted to meet the owl
He was looking for a river

questions.text: What can we guess about the fox at the end of the story?
options: He learned that a stick can help him
He decided to leave the forest
He gave the apple to the owl
He was angry with the owl

vocabulary.definition: a large area with many trees
a long, thin piece of wood

paragraph_translations: Bir zamanlar küçük bir tilki varmış. Büyük bir ormanda yaşarmış. Tilki çok acıkmış. Bir gün, bir ağacın altında kırmızı bir elma buldu.
Tilki zıpladı ve zıpladı, ama elma çok yüksekteydi. Sonra bilge, yaşlı bir baykuş geldi. Baykuş, "Bir sopa bul." dedi. Tilki sopayı kullandı ve elmayı aldı. Çok mutlu oldu.
